sections.bio:
With 15 years of hands-on design experience, I’ve grown from a visual designer to a UX Director leading multidisciplinary teams that create scalable, human-centered products. I specialize in building design systems, nurturing creative teams, and aligning design decisions with strategic business outcomes.
My journey has been shaped by collaborations with global tech companies, where I’ve led 30+ large-scale projects across domains like e-commerce, education, logistics, and manufacturing. I take pride in being both a mentor and a maker — designing frameworks that help others grow while pushing design thinking into the core of business strategy.

Driven by curiosity and continuous learning, I’m passionate about integrating logic, empathy, and innovation into every product. I believe great design is where systems meet soul — structured, purposeful, and deeply human.

🔹 UX Leadership | Product Strategy | System Design | Team Mentorship
🔹 100+ Projects | 30+ Designers Trained | 15 Years of Experience
📍 Currently exploring the intersection of design, AI, and creative entrepreneurship.
